verdict: Meta ads went dark five days ago; lead flow has stopped.
narrative: Meta advertising has run at $0 spend for five consecutive days (August 6–10), which is the direct cause of leads falling 58% week-over-week — this is a delivery issue, not a creative or cost problem. Across the full 28-day window you received 67 leads at $25.22 per lead, but that progress has been interrupted entirely by the current outage. Organic Instagram reach has also dropped sharply in the same period, suggesting the two issues share a root cause at the account level. We are actively working to restore Meta delivery and will confirm resolution with you directly. Once ads are back live, lead volume should return to prior-week levels quickly given that cost per lead was actually improving before the outage.
